description:
Umoja Dance Festival ROMANIA 2026
Presented by Kizomba Treat : Umoja Dance Festival, a family gathering, a celebration of togetherness through the universal language of dance! Rooted in the spirit of “Umoja,” meaning unity in Swahili, this festival is a proper blend of African and Worldwide cultures, creating a space where traditions, stories and experiences come alive.❤️
Immerse yourself in a weekend that will awaken and delight all your senses!
Whether you’re dancing together as a family, enjoying authentic music, or savoring cultural delights, the Umoja Dance Festival is more than an event, it’s a celebration of oneness, tradition, and shared humanity.💖
Join us and let’s move in harmony, celebrating what unites us!
